-- Keep publication and operator-side editing aligned with the review workflow.
-- This migration mirrors the production hardening applied during the structural audit.

alter table public.experiences
  drop constraint if exists experiences_published_requires_approval;

alter table public.experiences
  add constraint experiences_published_requires_approval
  check (published = false or review_status = 'approved');

drop policy if exists "operator owners can create own experiences" on public.experiences;
create policy "operator owners can create own experiences"
on public.experiences
for insert
to authenticated
with check (
  published = false
  and review_status = 'draft'
  and exists (
    select 1 from public.operator_memberships m
    where m.operator_id = experiences.operator_id
      and m.user_id = auth.uid()
      and m.role in ('owner','manager')
  )
);

drop policy if exists "operator owners can update own unpublished experiences" on public.experiences;
create policy "operator owners can update own unpublished experiences"
on public.experiences
for update
to authenticated
using (
  published = false
  and review_status in ('draft','rejected')
  and exists (
    select 1 from public.operator_memberships m
    where m.operator_id = experiences.operator_id
      and m.user_id = auth.uid()
      and m.role in ('owner','manager')
  )
)
with check (
  published = false
  and review_status in ('draft','rejected','pending')
  and exists (
    select 1 from public.operator_memberships m
    where m.operator_id = experiences.operator_id
      and m.user_id = auth.uid()
      and m.role in ('owner','manager')
  )
);

migrations.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.archive_completed_experience_review()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_revision_id uuid;
begin
  if old.review_status = 'pending' and new.review_status = 'approved' then
    select id into v_revision_id
    from public.experience_revisions
    where experience_id = new.id and status = 'pending'
    order by coalesce(submitted_at, created_at) desc
    limit 1;

    if v_revision_id is not null then
      update public.experience_revisions
      set status = 'applied',
          reviewed_at = coalesce(new.reviewed_at, now()),
          applied_at = now(),
          review_notes = coalesce(old.review_notes, review_notes),
          review_sections = case when old.review_sections is not null and old.review_sections <> '{}'::jsonb then old.review_sections else review_sections end,
          content = jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
            'name', new.name,
            'excerpt', new.excerpt,
            'description', new.description,
            'duration_minutes', new.duration_minutes,
            'price_from', new.price_from,
            'bookable', new.bookable,
            'meeting_point', new.meeting_point,
            'territory_id', new.territory_id,
            'category_id', new.category_id,
            'review_snapshot', coalesce(old.review_snapshot, '{}'::jsonb)
          )),
          updated_at = now()
      where id = v_revision_id;
    else
      insert into public.experience_revisions (
        experience_id, operator_id, status, draft_step, content, media,
        review_notes, review_sections, submitted_at, reviewed_at, applied_at,
        created_at, updated_at
      ) values (
        new.id, new.operator_id, 'applied',
        greatest(0, least(coalesce(old.draft_step, 0), 4)),
        jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
          'name', new.name,
          'excerpt', new.excerpt,
          'description', new.description,
          'duration_minutes', new.duration_minutes,
          'price_from', new.price_from,
          'bookable', new.bookable,
          'meeting_point', new.meeting_point,
          'territory_id', new.territory_id,
          'category_id', new.category_id,
          'review_snapshot', coalesce(old.review_snapshot, '{}'::jsonb)
        )),
        '[]'::jsonb, old.review_notes, coalesce(old.review_sections, '{}'::jsonb),
        old.updated_at, coalesce(new.reviewed_at, now()), now(), now(), now()
      );
    end if;
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$
;
revoke all on function public.archive_completed_experience_review() from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.archive_completed_experience_review() to service_role;
create trigger trg_archive_completed_experience_review after update on public.experiences for each row execute function public.archive_completed_experience_review();

migrations.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.accept_operator_application(p_application_id uuid, p_slug text, p_why_selected text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_publish boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  application_row public.operator_applications%rowtype;
  created_place_id uuid;
  created_operator_id uuid;
  clean_slug text;
begin
  select * into application_row
  from public.operator_applications
  where id = p_application_id
  for update;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'operator application not found';
  end if;

  if application_row.status = 'rejected' then
    raise exception 'rejected application cannot be accepted';
  end if;

  clean_slug := lower(regexp_replace(trim(p_slug), '[^a-zA-Z0-9]+', '-', 'g'));
  clean_slug := trim(both '-' from clean_slug);

  if clean_slug = '' then
    raise exception 'invalid operator slug';
  end if;

  insert into public.places (slug, name, kind, address, google_maps_query)
  values (
    'operatore-' || clean_slug,
    application_row.business_name,
    'operator',
    coalesce(application_row.address, application_row.location),
    concat_ws(' ', application_row.business_name, application_row.location)
  )
  on conflict (slug) do update
    set name = excluded.name,
        kind = 'operator',
        address = excluded.address,
        google_maps_query = excluded.google_maps_query,
        updated_at = now()
  returning id into created_place_id;

  insert into public.operators (
    slug,
    name,
    description,
    category,
    address,
    phone,
    whatsapp,
    email,
    website,
    instagram,
    selection_status,
    why_selected,
    published,
    place_id
  ) values (
    clean_slug,
    application_row.business_name,
    application_row.description,
    application_row.category,
    coalesce(application_row.address, application_row.location),
    application_row.phone,
    application_row.whatsapp,
    application_row.email,
    application_row.website,
    application_row.instagram,
    'selected',
    p_why_selected,
    p_publish,
    created_place_id
  )
  returning id into created_operator_id;

  update public.operator_applications
  set status = 'accepted',
      reviewed_at = now(),
      review_notes = p_why_selected,
      operator_id = created_operator_id
  where id = p_application_id;

  return created_operator_id;
end;
$function$
;
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reject_operator_application(p_application_id uuid, p_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  update public.operator_applications
  set status = 'rejected',
      reviewed_at = now(),
      review_notes = p_notes
  where id = p_application_id;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'operator application not found';
  end if;
end;
$function$
;
revoke all on function public.accept_operator_application(uuid,text,text,boolean) from public,anon,authenticated;
revoke all on function public.reject_operator_application(uuid,text) from public,anon,authenticated;
grant execute on function public.accept_operator_application(uuid,text,text,boolean) to service_role;
grant execute on function public.reject_operator_application(uuid,text) to service_role;
